Hi Laura / Vivek —

Quick heads up: Diego is confirming his last day for the week of May 24 to facilitate a move out, and we need to put an interim manager in place for ML Infra while we run the open search. I recommend promoting Priya N.'s current IC lead role into the interim manager slot for 6–8 weeks. Priya has deep product knowledge and the team already escalates to her for oncall decisions.

Key asks:
- Can we get HR sign-off on a temporary manager assignment and the corresponding comp/bonus handling? (cc Sarah from People Ops)
- Vivek — can your team run the handoff checklist and confirm coverage for the next two sprints?
- Laura — please confirm whether we should schedule a skip-level all-hands announcement and a small comms note for customers if we see any risk to SLA.

I've attached a draft transfer authorization form and an org snapshot showing reporting lines. I can own the comms + 1:1 cadence setup.

Planned timeline:
1) HR approval by May 11
2) Formal interim assignment effective May 25
3) Handoff and 1:1s May 25–28

Thanks — want to move quickly so the team has continuity.

— Jordan
